author: Vishal Nanda
quote:
If you are debating whether to call Got Moles, stop reading and just call Spencer. You won’t be disappointed.

I was struggling with a pesky mole tearing up my new lawn. I tried everything—worms, gas bombs, DIY traps, castor oil—and wasted over $150 and countless hours with zero results. I finally threw in the towel and called the professionals, and I’m so glad I did.

Talking to the owner, Spencer, was a breath of fresh air. He is a straight shooter who didn’t try to oversell me. He spent 20 minutes educating me and, knowing my home was listed for sale, suggested a cost-effective plan rather than locking me into a complicated pricing scheme like other companies I called.

Tavis, the technician, was fantastic. I was skeptical about how fast they could work, but Tavis nailed the location and caught the mole within 2 days of setting the traps. He was punctual with weekly follow-ups and super friendly.

The real test came three days after my service ended when a new mole moved in. Even though technically the service period was over, Spencer treated it as a warranty issue rather than selling me a new package. Tavis came back out, and bam—caught the second mole in 2 days.

Honest pricing, incredible results, and amazing customer service. Highly recommended!
